apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.22.0  (November 2026)  HELP: UPDATES INSTALL THEMSELVES
  - A new page, Help (at the bottom of the menu): Check for updates asks the download page for the newest version;
    Update now downloads it, closes Beacon Finance (with its usual backup and sync), installs it and opens it again.
    Windows asks once for permission: click Yes. The books are never touched.
  - Beacon Finance also looks by itself 20 seconds after it opens and asks (Later / Update now); this can be turned off.
  - The User Guide (a PDF with pictures of every page) comes with the next update: Help → Open the User Guide.
  - Install this version by hand once (from the download page); after that, updates come through Help.

apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.32.0: HELP: UPDATES INSTALL THEMSELVES - A new page, Help (at the bottom of the menu). Check for updates asks the download page for the newest version; Update now downloads it, closes the program (with its usual backup and sync), installs it and opens the program again. Windows asks once for permission: click Yes. The program also looks by itself 20 seconds after it opens and asks (Later / Update now). The church records are never touched. The User Guide (a PDF with pictures) comes with the next update; Open the User Guide opens it. This version must be installed by hand once (from the download page); after that, updates come through Help. ALSO: Publish & Notify also sends the last three activities, so members see them in the portal under Church → Schedule → Recent (Website Update 110).
